note: Festivals the city keeps, and when. Each `on` is one year's run: `start` and `end` bound the season, `peak` is the night it builds to, and the shelf appears `lead` days before `start`. A record joins with `"festival": "<id>"`; `match` words pull in the city feed's own listings by title. Read by the festival shelf in js/app.js. Dates that move (Diwali, Lunar New Year) are entered per year — check them each autumn.

items.name: Halloween
items.line: The Village Halloween Parade, the Great Jack O'Lantern Blaze and costumes on every subway car.

items.name: Thanksgiving
items.line: The Macy's parade, the balloon inflation the night before, then a long lunch.

items.name: Christmas
items.line: Rockefeller's tree, the windows on Fifth and the holiday markets.

items.name: New Year's Eve
items.line: Times Square if you must. Prospect Park's fireworks if you'd rather see them.

items.name: Lunar New Year
items.line: Firecrackers in Chinatown and Flushing, and the parade on Mott Street.

items.name: Diwali
items.line: Diwali at Times Square and lights across Jackson Heights.
